caption: The drawing depicts a single glass vessel positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background bordered by a thin line. The vessel has a bulbous, rounded body rendered in a rich, translucent red color, with the upper rim and a portion of the body near the handles displaying slight highlights. There are two large, clear, curved handles attached symmetrically to either side of the upper portion of the vessel. The vessel stands on a tall, slender stem and a wide circular base, both shaded in hues of white and gray, signifying a transparent or glass material. The shadows and contours on the base and around the vessel emphasize its three-dimensional form. The artist's signature, "Michael Treku," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Vase
